title: Boneo Community Market
summary: Peninsula's longest-running volunteer-run community market. Third Saturday, year-round, all weather. Make it, grow it, bake it: real homemade and homegrown.
description: Mornington Peninsula's longest-running volunteer-operated community market. Held every third Saturday of the month year-round in all weather. 'Make it, Grow it, Bake it' philosophy. Homemade/homegrown produce, craft, art, plants, food. Animal farm and face painters for kids; live music buskers. Proceeds support Boneo Tennis Club, Cricket Club and Primary School.
weatherDependency: Outdoor – runs in all weather conditions
nearbyAttractions: Rye beach; Rye Foreshore playground; Rosebud foreshore
suggestedItineraryPairing: Morning market then Rye beach afternoon
kidsGradeNote: Animal farm and face painters for kids, plenty of room to wander on the grassed reserve, pram-friendly.
editorVerdict: Boneo's monthly Saturday: the Peninsula's longest-running volunteer market, and it acts like it. Locals-first, low-key, no hype.
editorNote:
Boneo Community Market runs the third Saturday of every month at the rec reserve, year-round, in whatever weather. It is genuinely make-it, grow-it, bake-it, which is the polite way of saying you will not find imported homewares dressed up as artisan. Proceeds prop up the local tennis club, cricket club and primary school.

Go if you live south of Rosebud or you are passing through on the way to the back beaches. Not a destination market. Bring cash, bring kids (animal farm, face painters, room to run), expect to be done in an hour.

The move: pair it with a Rye beach morning or a coffee at Cape Schanck on the way through.
